subject: SummitBridge — consolidated credits + term exception request
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SummitBridge — consolidated credits + term exception request

Team — quick summary and ask. SummitBridge (Alex Carter) has been in a POC for 6 weeks; they like the runtime performance but are sensitive on cost and procurement timing. Customer asked for: (1) 3-month trial extension to reach SLOs, (2) $50k in platform credits to cover evaluation burst, and (3) a 20% first-year discount on committed spend if they sign a 12-month MPA by 5/26.

Why I think we should approve: they have clear technical blockers that the extra run-time will resolve, legal is comfortable with our standard MPA (attached), and the account maps to a 200k ARR conservative first-year estimate. Our ask: exec signoff to approve combined exception (credits + discount + trial extension).

Attachments: SB_Proposal_v3.pdf (proposal), SOC2-redacted.pdf (security evidence).

Requested decision: Approve combined package up to $60k credits and 20% discount, conditional on signed MPA by 2028-05-26. Please reply with "approve" or "decline" and any constraints.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitBridge — consolidated credits + term exception request

Naomi — thanks for the concise note. A couple clarifying items before I greenlight:
- Can you confirm committed ARR forecast if we give 20% year one? Need the revenue math in the deck.
- Is SOC2 sufficient for their procurement or do they need additional evidence?
- What's the recommended credit structure (one-time trial top-up vs staged/onboarding credits)?

If the ARR projection is >$150k and SOC2 satisfies procurement, I'm inclined to approve up to $60k credits, but prefer discount closer to 15% unless Rishi okays 20%. Loop finance if the credits hit the envelope.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole | Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitBridge — consolidated credits + term exception request

Thanks Naomi/Marissa. Read the proposal. Approve in principle: up to $60k in credits and up to 20% discount on year one, contingent on signed 12-month MPA by 2028-05-26 and finance signoff on revenue recognition. Please get procurement timebox in writing (they must sign by the deadline).

Grace — please prepare a one-off onboarding credit (to be consumed in the first 90 days) so we can tie it to milestones. Naomi — when you send the external offer, make the DocuSign link time-limited and include the commit milestones.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | SVP, Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@summitbridge.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Formal offer: SummitBridge trial extension + credits + term discount (DocuSign)

Alex — per our call, appreciate the urgency. We (Redwood) are prepared to offer the following to help you finish validation:
1) Trial extension: 90 additional days of POC access (same capacity tier)
2) Platform credits: $50,000 one-time credit to be applied during the extended POC window
3) Commercial concession: 20% discount on first-year committed spend, conditional on signing a 12-month MPA by 2028-05-26

Conditions: Signed MPA (DocuSign) by 2028-05-26; credits applied after start of extended POC; standard data handling and audit controls (SOC2) as attached.

DocuSign (please sign by 5/26): https://app.docusign.com/embedded/signing/EXAMPLE-DS-12345
Attachments: SB_Proposal_v3.pdf, SOC2-redacted.pdf

If you want the discount restructured (stair-step or commit thresholds) we can discuss, but this is the packaged approval Rishi authorized.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@summitbridge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@summitbridge.com
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Formal offer: SummitBridge trial extension + credits + term discount (DocuSign)

Naomi — thanks, this looks good and exactly what the engineering team needs to finish load testing. I initiated DocuSign and routed to procurement. One ask: can we delay the first invoice by 30 days after go-live? Procurement will review and confirm. Signed MPA will be uploaded once procurement clears.

I’ll keep you posted — Alex
Alex Carter | Head of Platform Engineering, SummitBridge
alex.carter@summitbridge.com
Attachments: SummitBridge_signed-MPA.pdf (pending upload by procurement)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 May 2028 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitBridge — consolidated credits + term exception request

Marissa / Rishi / Grace — loop closed: Alex confirmed procurement routing and expects signed MPA by EOD 5/23; they also requested a 30-day invoice delay after go-live. Procurement indicated SOC2 is sufficient. I uploaded the DocuSign link and will watch for signed MPA (they said they will attach SummitBridge_signed-MPA.pdf).

Grace — please schedule the onboarding credit to be available immediately after the contract effective date and tag it to SB-2028-042 in the ledger. Marissa/Rishi — please mark the deal in HubSpot as "contracting: awaiting signature" and note the concession in the deal comments.

Thanks — Naomi
